description: List recorded French property-transfer prices (DVF -- Demandes de valeurs foncieres, published by DGFiP) for a commune or postcode, optionally filtered by date range and property type. Each result is one recorded disposition (a specific parcel/lot in a transaction) with price, address-level commune, parcel id, property type, built surface, land surface, room count and coordinates. Pass commune as either a 5-digit INSEE code (e.g. "75111" for Paris 11e) or a commune name (e.g. "Lyon" matches all 9 Lyon arrondissements; "Paris 11e Arrondissement"). Use for "property sales in Paris 11e in 2025" or "recent house sales in Annecy". Covers a rolling five years; excludes Alsace, Moselle and Mayotte (see data_as_of/coverage_note in the response).

commune.description: 5-digit INSEE commune code (e.g. "75111") or a commune name (case-insensitive prefix match, e.g. "Lyon").

type.description: Property type: "Maison" (house), "Appartement" (apartment), "Dépendance" (outbuilding), or "Local industriel. commercial ou assimilé" (commercial/industrial).
